findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name URL open / system sinks in package_index
 * @description Inventory of network and command sinks in package_index and easy_install
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/setuptools-net-sinks
 */

import python

from Call c, string attr, string f
where
  f = c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() and
  f in ["setuptools/package_index.py", "setuptools/command/easy_install.py", "setuptools/archive_util.py"] and
  c.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = attr and
  attr in ["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "system", "popen", "download", "extractall", "extract"]
select c, attr + " call at line " + c.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: package_index/easy_install/archive_util contain network/command/archive-extraction sinks relevant to RCE and path traversal (CVE-2024-6345, CVE-2025-47273)

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name shell=True subprocess usage
 * @description Detects subprocess invocations requesting a shell
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/setuptools-shell-true
 */

import python

from Call call, Keyword k
where
  k = call.getAKeyword() and
  k.getArg() = "shell" and
  k.getValue().(Name).getId() = "True"
select call, "subprocess call with shell=True"
findings.hypothesis: Command injection risk via subprocess calls with shell=True

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name os.system/popen sinks in package_index.py with context
 * @description Lists command execution sinks and their enclosing function and first argument text
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/setuptools-pkgindex-sinks-ctx
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function f
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
  and call.getScope() = f
  and call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "setuptools/package_index.py"
select call, "in " + f.getName() + " arg: " + call.getArg(0).toString()
findings.hypothesis: os.system calls in package_index.py take a parameter (downloaded/remote-derived content) as command - code injection (CVE-2024-6345 class)
CVE-2024-6345: URL argument to package_index download helpers flows unsanitized into os.system, allowing command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name setuptools unsafe archive extraction
 * @description Archive extraction primitives (Zip Slip / tar traversal candidates)
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/setuptools-unsafe-extract
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string name
where
  call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember(["ZipFile", "extractall"]).getACall() and
  name = "zipfile"
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["TarFile", "open", "extractall"]).getACall() and
  name = "tarfile"
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["unpack_archive", "unpack_tarfile", "unpack_zipfile"]).getACall() and
  name = "shutil"
select call, "Archive extraction via " + name
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe archive extraction allowing path traversal (Zip Slip) in setuptools archive_util / package_index

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name setuptools unsafe deserialization sites
 * @description pickle/marshal/eval usage outside vendored code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/setuptools-deser
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%_vendor%")
  and not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%/_vendor/%")
  and (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
    or call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
    or call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("eval").getACall()
    or call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("exec").getACall()
  )
select call, "Unsafe deserialization/dynamic execution site"
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization or dynamic code execution on untrusted data (CWE-502/CWE-95) in non-vendored setuptools code.
